svg.title: Banksia — cone + serrated leaves
svg.desc: Cone 120 mm long · leaves 90 mm. Roll the scored cone strip into a tapered cylinder on a wire, glue the seam. Shape each scale into a shallow cup and glue on in rows from the base up, overlapping like roof tiles. Tape the serrated leaves in pairs down the stem.
